description: This is a migration script for the Apache Superset project, specifically handling the migration of native filters to a new schema. It includes functions for upgrading and downgrading dashboard metadata related to filters, and interacts with the database via SQLAlchemy and Alembic.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: Declarative SQLAlchemy class representing dashboards, used for querying dashboard metadata during migration.

methods.name: upgrade_filters
methods.description: Transforms native filter dictionaries by moving 'defaultValue' into 'defaultDataMask.filterState'.

methods.name: downgrade_filters
methods.description: Reverts the transformation by moving 'defaultDataMask.filterState' back into 'defaultValue'.

methods.name: upgrade_dashboard
methods.description: Applies filter upgrades to a dashboard's metadata dictionary.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Main function to perform the upgrade on all dashboards with native filter configurations.

methods.name: downgrade_dashboard
methods.description: Reverts filter upgrades in a dashboard's metadata dictionary.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Main function to perform the downgrade on all dashboards with native filter configurations.
